messages:
alex k: Heads-up — NovaGov POC: procurement sent a security questionnaire. They require GovCloud + VPC-only deployment, SCIM with near-real-time diffs, nested group support, SAML assertions encrypted, and short session lifetimes. Demo requested next Tue. Can eng/security confirm feasibility + any price delta for Dedicated vs Hosted?
maria s: Ack. Can you paste the questionnaire excerpt? Also, do they want air-gapped on-prem or just a GovCloud VPC? that changes the presales ask.
alex k: Pasted excerpt below (snip):
```
- Deployment: GovCloud, VPC-only, no public endpoints allowed
- Identity: SAML 2.0, EncryptedAssertion required; SCIM v2 with near-real-time delta sync and nested groups
- Controls: KMS/HSM for keys, audit logs >= 1 year, token rotation policy
- Compliance: FedRAMP / gov-specific export controls questions
```
devon p: GovCloud + VPC-only implies Private/Dedicated deployment. If they truly want air-gapped on-prem we move to our on-prem package (longer lead time + enterprise license).
SCIM "near-real-time" needs clarification — our SCIM supports delta tokens + short polling; sub-10s is tricky. We can offer webhook change notifications + a 30s delta poll for POC. That should meet most "near-RT" asks without custom plumbing.
jamal: @alex k please loop me on the questionnaire. High level: we can provide SOC2, attest to TLS1.2+/mTLS options, KMS integration, and HSM support for private deployments. For SAML EncryptedAssertion we support EncryptedAssertion + per-tenant certs. Need legal for FedRAMP/export control language.
maria s: Pricing note: Dedicated GovCloud will carry a premium + setup fee; on-prem is a separate enterprise license. If you can confirm expected user count and peak provisioning rate, I can model cost for Dedicated vs Hosted POC.
alex k: Customer estimate: ~50k users total, onboarding bursts up to ~2000 users/min during initial sync. Demo needs a tenant with nested groups and delegated admin flows. Can we have a sandbox GovCloud environment for demo by Monday?
devon p: We can spin a short-lived Dedicated GovCloud sandbox. ETA ~48h once we have: (1) customer IP allowlist, (2) SAML metadata, and (3) POA for accessing GovCloud region. I also need to confirm SCIM rate-limits for the POC; current default is 1 req/sec per token but we can transiently raise for onboarding windows with autoscaling on Dedicated.
alex k: I have SAML metadata inbound. I'll request their IPs. They also asked for delegated-admin patterns: project-level role assignment via SCIM group mapping — do we support nested group->role translation?
devon p: Yes, we flatten nested groups into a role mapping table on inbound sync. It's configurable per-tenant; we just need their mapping CSV (group -> role) and a sample nested group structure.
jamal: I'll draft responses for the security questionnaire (include SOC2 link, KMS flow diagram, audit log retention policy). Also include our token rotation cadence and SCIM token handling. Can someone attach SCIM rate-limit & rotation docs?
maria s: I'll put together a commercial sketch: 3-month POC discount, Dedicated GovCloud monthly estimate + one-time setup. Will add notes for on-prem enterprise licensing if they want airgapped. Draft link: http://intra.redwood/presales/gov-poc (internal).
alex k: Action items: @jamal — draft questionnaire answers (EOD today). @devon p — confirm sandbox ETA + SCIM rate-limit doc (tomorrow AM). @maria s — preliminary pricing sheet (EOD). I'll follow up with customer for IPs + SAML metadata. Thanks all :thumbsup:
